nomination_rule: No automatic nomination or promotion. Report every frozen comparison, seed, date, effect magnitude and frequency; intervals crossing zero do not automatically reject an improvement.
limitations: Retrospective development dates reused; tokenizer pretraining overlap remains unresolved. Full available archived eligible universe is not all ever-listed A-shares. Original historical eligibility, source adjustment and membership limitations remain. Dated industry snapshots are reconstructed, not certified original publication vintages. Context comprises index, market breadth/liquidity and dated sector peers at the signal close only; sector peers exclude the target. Unknown sectors remain missing. New context arm gets the same original parent, 7969 training rows, four epochs and fixed loss weights. Earlier three arms reuse frozen completed checkpoints. All four arms use matched 64-path inference over all eligible stocks on the same 71 evaluation dates. Training gradients still use eight-path bags and individual-model objectives versus ensemble reporting. Daily extrema returns are scenarios, not executed profits. No test-based tuning, live promotion, scheduler or sealed-holdout access.
inference_backend: cached causal attention and decoder prefixes; original sorted multinomial RNG; validated numerically against full-prefix inference
